title: 009 olovnice
prompt: Macro close-up at ground level of the very first course of huge perfectly cut foundation stones of a castle wall set on bare bedrock, a mason's brass plumb bob hangs perfectly still on its string right beside the stone edge proving it is straight, a spirit level and an iron chisel lie on the stone, fine stone dust, warm low sunlight raking across the texture. No people, no hands. Palette: warm amber, honey, pale limestone, grey bedrock, brass, no teal. No text.
